source.name: Feyenoord, 'Feyenoord en MediaMarkt verlengen tot 2030' (Wayback capture of feyenoord.com)
source.quote: Het in april 2024 afgesloten hoofdpartnerschap met de grootste elektronicaketen van Europa is tot medio 2030 verlengd.
source.note: Main sponsor = front of shirt. Kit photos confirm the MediaMarkt wordmark centre front (Football Shirt Culture and Footy Headlines galleries, 30 June 2026). Feyenoord.com's site header in the July 2026 capture likewise carries the MediaMarkt logo as 'Media Markt' main sponsor (/assets/sponsors/main-sponsor.svg, visually confirmed as the MediaMarkt wordmark). Football Shirt Culture's article text misnames the front sponsor as 'EuroParcs' - the photos and club releases show MediaMarkt.

source.name: Feyenoord, 'Eurojackpot nieuwe Premium Partner van Feyenoord' (Wayback capture of feyenoord.com)
source.quote: Eurojackpot siert tot 2030 de mouw van het thuis- en uitshirt van Feyenoord 1 en Feyenoord Vrouwen 1.
source.note: Sleeve partner on the home and away shirts from 2026-27. Nederlandse Loterij, of which Eurojackpot is part, is the contracting party. Gambling operator - see sponsor record for ownership.

source.name: Feyenoord, 'Feyenoord en Prijsvrij Vakanties verlengen en breiden Partnership uit' (Wayback capture of feyenoord.nl)
source.quote: Afgelopen seizoen werd Prijsvrij zelfs de eerste Back-of-shirt Partner van de club, waardoor de naam prominent op de rug van de shirts van het eerste elftal te zien was.
source.note: Same release: the agreement runs 'tot met seizoen 2026-2027', covering this kit. Back-of-shirt printing on the 2026-27 home shirt confirmed by the Football Shirt Culture gallery photo showing 'PRIJSVRIJ vakanties' across the upper back (https://www.footballshirtculture.com/new-kits/feyenoord-jersey-26-27-home-castore.html, 30 June 2026).

source.name: Feyenoord, 'Fairphone sluit zich aan bij samenwerking tussen Feyenoord en MediaMarkt' (live page; no Wayback snapshot exists)
source.quote: wordt het merk vanaf het seizoen 2026/2027 zichtbaar tijdens wedstrijden en op de broeken van de wedstrijdtenues van Feyenoord 1 en Feyenoord Vrouwen 1.
source.note: Premium Affiliate Partner of both Feyenoord and MediaMarkt; visible on the match shorts from 2026/2027. Page read live via a reader proxy (r.jina.ai) because feyenoord.com blocks direct fetches; web.archive.org holds no snapshot of this URL as of 2026-09-28.

source.name: Football Shirt Culture, 'Feyenoord 2026-27 Home Kit by Castore Revealed'
source.quote: Feyenoord Rotterdam have unveiled the Feyenoord 26/27 Home kit, produced by Castore for the 2026-27 season.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Footy Headlines (30 June 2026) carries the same launch: 'Feyenoord and Castore have officially launched the club's new home kit for the 2026-2027 season.'

source.name: Feyenoord, 'QTerminals nieuwe Official Training Partner van Feyenoord' (Wayback capture of feyenoord.com)
source.quote: waardoor QTerminals de komende drie jaar met het logo op de trainingslijn komt te staan.
source.note: Three-year Official Training Partner deal running from season 2024-25, so it covers 2026-27 training wear; not a placement on the match shirt. Recorded for completeness.

summary: MediaMarkt on the front (main partner to mid-2030), Eurojackpot on the sleeve (2026-2030, home and away shirts), Prijsvrij Vakanties on the back (back-of-shirt partner through season 2026-27), Fairphone on the shorts (from 2026/2027) and Castore as kit maker. QTerminals sits on the training line, not the match shirt. Quooker (partner to mid-2029) took the sleeve in 2025-26 for KNVB Beker and European matches only; with Eurojackpot taking the 2026-27 sleeve its logo is not on this Eredivisie home shirt. Kit photos show no other sponsor marks.
